notes.title: Small Update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Cleaned up some bugs and UI glitches
You can no longer accidentally switch skin while scrolling on the leaderboard
Added support for more alphabets in steam usernames

notes.title: Small Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Increased number of displayed scores on the leaderboard 
Fixed over 20 bugs and glitches
Smoothened animations
Fixed audio jittering on high-end systems
Balanced move logic

notes.title: Hotfix Wed 28 Sep
notes.notes:
Fixed support for korean and japanese characters when combined with cyrillic characters
Added an option to disable the camera bouncing

notes.title: Hotfix for non-latin usernames
notes.notes: Added a new font so Chinese and other non-latin script usernames show up on the leaderboard

notes.title: Hotfix Mon 26 Sep
notes.notes: Reduced the level requirements to allow more new players to play modes

notes.title: Hotfix (v 1.0)
notes.notes:
Fixed resolution looking weird on high res screens
 Added more on hover animations to all buttons
 Renamed and shuffled some skins

notes.title: Small Update v0.9.0
notes.notes:
Fixed 12 bugs
Improved animation smoothness
Added hover animations for every button
